the other working days. A manager can approve a different arrangement for a specific week. Any change
must be recorded in the team calendar so colleagues can plan coverage. Public holidays follow the annual
company calendar rather than an individual employee's preferred schedule.
1.2 Annual leave
Every full-time employee receives 20 days of paid annual leave per calendar year. Employees joining
during the year receive a prorated allowance. Request annual leave at least five working days before the
first day away. The line manager approves requests after checking team coverage. Up to five unused
days may carry over into the following year, and those carried days expire on March 31. Leave is counted
in working days; weekends and company public holidays do not reduce the allowance. An employee
should arrange a handover before leaving and add an out-of-office message naming the colleague
providing cover.
1.3 Sick leave and equipment
Employees receive 10 days of paid sick leave each calendar year. Notify the line manager before 09:00
on the first day of illness when possible. A medical certificate is required for absences longer than three
consecutive working days. Unused sick

3 Sick leave and equipment
Employees receive 10 days of paid sick leave each calendar year. Notify the line manager before 09:00
on the first day of illness when possible. A medical certificate is required for absences longer than three
consecutive working days. Unused sick leave does not carry over. The company supplies one laptop and
one headset to each full-time employee. Report lost equipment to the IT help desk immediately. Home
internet reimbursement is capped at NPR 1,500 per month and requires a receipt. Equipment must be
returned within three working days of the final employment date. These rules apply to employees, not
independent contractors.

every Friday, and approved claims are paid in the next payroll cycle. Missing receipts delay review.
Personal purchases and fines are not reimbursed. Foreign travel requires written approval before booking,
but this handbook does not specify international meal allowances. Ask Finance for that policy rather than
assuming domestic limits apply abroad. All figures in this handbook are fictional demo data.

promise a refund before checking eligibility. Return transport for an approved damaged product is paid by
the company.
